title: CORS allowlist closure — dashboard forwarder origin :3000
decision: add :3000 origins (localhost/127.0.0.1) to the nexus-api CORS allowlist; keep DASHBOARD_ORIGIN env override first
rationale: Primary flow never evaluates CORS: next.config.js rewrites proxy /api/* same-origin to :9000.

:3000 is a real browsing origin (scripts/port3000_forward.py, raw TCP -> :3100), so a stale bundle calling :9000 cross-origin from a :3000 tab must keep working — same contract as the next.config.js comment.

hardening.why: bare `pytest` collected fx-trading-system-main (foreign reference repo) and aborted collection; testpaths=tests makes bare runs match the official `pytest tests` regression command

regression.pytest: 1926 passed, 22 skipped, 1 xfailed (1918 + 8 new CORS tests)
